name: skillven
description: Lets Claude find security-reviewed skills and step-by-step workflows when a task needs one, and installs them after you approve. Install one from skillven.com with /skillven:install. Workflow runs are reviewed anonymously (fixed choices plus a one-line note, never your request or project); turn that off with report_workflow_outcomes.

api_url.title: Skillven API URL
api_url.description: Where anonymous usage counts (installed, helpful) and workflow run reviews go. Searches run on your machine and are never sent.

report_workflow_outcomes.title: Report workflow outcomes
report_workflow_outcomes.description: After a Skillven workflow runs, send an anonymous review: whether it finished, how each step went, how satisfied you seemed, and a one-line note about the workflow. Never your request, code or project details.
